gaps.claim: clone_capital() sums current_balance_usdc, which since their #94 fix excludes the bot's open stakes, so book() counts money committed inside the bot as free cash (400 now).
book() does float(clone_capital or 0): an unreadable bot balance is counted as zero, the direction clone_capital's docstring forbids.
cloned_bots.settings is declared executable with no required_flags and no script-level floor, unlike fund and toggle-trading.
clone()/fund()/enable() call response.json() after the POST unguarded; a 200 with a non-JSON body leaves an intent with no outcome (rule 9).
enable(): a failed my-clones re-read after a successful toggle raises SystemExit, so the after row is never written and the client is not closed.
close() records a definite 4xx refusal as outcome 'unknown', and nothing ever settles an unknown close.
answer() appends a second gave_up row on re-poll; only the #86 reader was fixed, every other reader of nexus.jsonl still double-counts.
rooms.py show names legs by basket label or card-id prefix, while the page names them by headline and never shows an id.

Asserts book(clone_capital=None)['cash'] equals a baseline that is also None, pinning the permissive reading its docstring forbids; affordable(99000, in_bots=None) is True while in_bots=1000 is False. The test side of R02.

Covers only a failed positions read; measurements() in test_paper_balance_moves.py:103-107 drops a trade whose balance is unparseable with continue, so a failed /account/me read makes newest() judge an older, pre-fix trade. Raised independently by the vendor auditor against tests/rest/test_paper_balance_moves.py::test_a_paper_buy_debits_the_paper_balance (its V07, merged here).

`must` omits event_cards.buy/sell/short and named_wrong walks only `must`, so event_cards.short with required_flags [confirm] lets a MUTATE POST without paper reach the transport with every guard green.

Negative controls (this and test_guidance_that_was_never_answered_is_refused) call clone(confirm=True); if the refusal stops raising, the test builds a mutate-enabled trusted client and POSTs a real paper clone -- the control needs the thing it tests.

Tests only closes(); the verdict logic inline at test_paper_close_returns_the_money.py:120-132 (the VISIBLE sub-cent condition) is untouched, so dropping it turns TRD-0004 into a false fail with the meta test green.
Accepts any Raise between the gate and the POST, so `if not can and not confirm:` makes the cap advisory for every confirmed order while the test stays green.

The detector wants only a gate call on an earlier line: a bare may_write_to_vendor() whose result is ignored passes, and client.post(url=SEND) is not seen at all (reads node.args[0] only). Latent today.

walk_listing returns (cards, False) at max_pages exactly like a finished walk and the listing check has no cap guard, so beyond 10,000 cards (6,880 today) a Nexus-named card past the cap is reported missing from the whole listing.

This guard and is_user_submission's docstring still state 'visible only to its author' and that reading a submission is a visibility defect; their #95 resolution says visibility keys on is_public. Docstring only, nothing reaches the vendor.

Three of the seven figures cannot fail: '10 000' and '+13 %' are substrings of the why text the test itself requires, 'BTC' is a substring of the title; removing the invested tile, the TP column and the basket label stays green.
'TRD-0001' and '10 000' are substrings of the status text required a line earlier, so dropping the trades list from the panel stays green.
Claims a headline is shorter than the sentence it heads but only checks it exists and is <= 90 chars; live today: #86's headline is 59 chars over a 47-char summary.
Both 'when' marks get the same timestamp and one substring check covers both, so stale_from printing a bare date stays green.
Only CSS rules whose selector contains .nx-compose are read; #nxCompose{position:sticky} or an inline style slips past.
The 'others keep their width' half is never asserted: deleting .wrap{max-width:1240px} makes every tab full width and stays green.
Every invalid-leg case is a one-leg list, so a set_plan that drops bad legs and writes the rest passes 'refused whole before anything is written'.
Only the data-sort='changed' attribute is checked, not the default readStore('qa.sort','changed') nor the order; a damage default stays green.
The closed P-2 shares P-1's card and the mock does not list it, so a follow() that keeps closed positions changes no path and no row -- reproduced by running.
'--sample 10' is found in the comment lines of console.cmd and console.sh, so removing it from the actual command stays green.

Security: 'a token minted at launch' is checked only as two different hosts giving different tokens; a token derived from the host (same across restarts, predictable) passes. Fixtures pass a fixed TOKEN, so nothing else tests note_token_for.
Only 45 min stale and 2 min fresh at every=600; a fixed threshold ignoring `every` passes, the 3*every is not pinned.
The regex \b{name}\.([a-z_]+)\b gives no match for a camelCase read like np.samplerOk, which would render undefined unseen. None today.

Fetches every UUID in the newest answer as a card, but answers name non-card UUIDs (NEX-0015 a species id, NEX-0010 a backtest run_id), and there is no age limit, so a species id or a card resolved after the answer fails as 'Nexus tells an agent to trade'.

Repaired today: nothing checks the include_user_submitted flag does anything (e.g. the flagged walk carries any user-submission card), and walk_listing stops on a short page even when total says more, so an ignored flag or a short page reads as a private card served to a non-owner.
Asserts only tradeable_now is True while the fail text says 'answer status live', and the walk stops on a short page while the fail text says 'walked through all N cards it hands out'.

Repaired today: every gave_up counts as 'did not answer', including the 15-minute give-up whose last status was our own unread/unknown read; and latest_per_question orders by the last row, so re-polling an old failed question moves it into the newest five.
Accepts only naming the excluded population though its own comment allows counting it; if they fold event cards into the counters, the check fails -- the #83 shape.

Credit must equal notional + pre-close unrealized within 0.01, so a fee or a cent of index move fails as 'does not credit'; `booked` accepts a move of either sign; closes() drops a close whose balance read failed, so an older close becomes the newest.
Calling verbs include with/via/through, so 'filter with `is_public`' or 'via `reward_amount`' becomes a tool that does not exist. No current answer triggers it.
A listing with no inputSchema key is read as {} and fails as 'empty inputSchema -- it takes no arguments', so a partial schema read is reported as a defect.
The fail text states 'funding it with that key returns 401 with an empty body', which no branch measures; routes whose auth is declared via openapi security are skipped as public.
The fail text says an agent 'cannot start it through any documented endpoint' whichever path is hidden, e.g. an undocumented DELETE beside a documented /settings.
